items.title: Fever Notebook: Damiris Dantas undergoes season-ending knee surgery
items.body_excerpt: Dantas appeared in 12 games this season, her third with the Fever. (Photo: Ryan May/800 Meter) Damiris Dantas was the last player to join the Indiana Fever in training camp (due to Visa delays) and the first to have her season come to an end. The veteran center underwent surgery…
